{{Quote|Never forget that one, my dear. Arguing that the defendant's delusions justified bypassing the security system was inspired. But actually proving that she had, in her own mind, purchased the vehicle was pure genius.|Eramuth Bwua'tu to Sardonne Sardon|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
The '''Travaless case''' was a trial that the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]] [[Sardonne Sardon]] won sometime before [[43 ABY]]. Famed lawyer [[Eramuth Bwua'tu]] was impressed with Sardon's work in the case, particularly in gaining an acquittal by arguing that the [[Gender/Legends|female]] defendant was suffering delusions when she stole the [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], and proving successfully that the crazed defendant genuinely thought she had purchased the speeder.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex" />
